summary: Seadrill Finance Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Seadrill Ltd, issued $700 million aggregate principal amount of 6.750% Senior Notes due 2034 under Rule 144A/Reg S. The notes are guaranteed by Seadrill Ltd and certain subsidiaries, governed by an Indenture with GLAS Trust as trustee, mature July 15, 2034, with semi-annual interest. Redemption provisions include make-whole premium before July 15, 2029, and step-down prices thereafter. This is a routine debt issuance to raise capital, not a special situation transaction. No change of control, tender offer, or restructuring event is present; the filing simply reports a material debt agreement.
